split_procedure: Records in source_files order, then file order; random.Random(split_seed).shuffle; train = first int(0.2*n), val = next int(0.1*n), test = the rest. Then every record with an option containing exclude_option_text is removed from its split; the rest keep their split and order.
exclude_option_text: One of the remaining options is correct, but a stronger result can be proven.
notes: This is an ID split manifest, not the full LiveMathematicianBench payload. Materialize full split items from the official raw qa_*_final.json files at source_revision before evaluation.
